content:
Just an update here on the release process: everything upstream of Mathlib is now on v4.30.0-rc1, but we haven't quite got Mathlib there. @Joscha Mennicken and I are both limited availability of this long weekend, so I'm posting a bit of a checklist here, in case anyone can help get things over the line.

  • nightly#204, which merges bump/nightly-2026-03-31 into bump/v4.30.0 is currently with bors.
  • nightly#205, which wants to merge bump/nightly-2026-04-01 into bump/v4.30.0 still needs review and merging (it may be necessary to manually merge bump/v4.30.0 back into bump/nightly-2026-04-01 and resolve any merge conflicts before nightly#205 can be merged).
  • After those are both in, #37564 wants to merge bump/v4.30.0 into master (and should not need separate review, beyond any final tweaks to get things green) (again, it may need a manual merge of master into bump/v4.30.0 if any conflicts arise in the meanwhile, but it is good right now).

Help appreciated on all of these, both reviewing, dealing with review issues, resolving merge conflicts, and actually merging, as appropriate.

(I will probably cart my laptop around the folk festival I'm attending today, and try to keep pushing things along. But :dancer: may intervene. :-)

Can you bors merge nightly#204 again? I just pushed https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4-nightly-testing/pull/204/changes/00a2ad360205c46f4cee3c7094c91561fef8a984 which is a fix I already put into nightly-testing

Updates:

  • [X] nightly#204
  • [X] I have merged master into bump/v4.30.0, bump/v4.30.0 into bump/nightly-2026-04-01, fixing a variety of merge conflicts, and merged bump/nightly-2026-04-01 into nightly-testing, hoping to keep everything in sync!
  • [ ] But we still need to review/pass CI/merge nightly#205
The diff for Partrec.lean for nightly#205 looks like a botched merge, sorry. Otherwise I think it is good to go.
Okay, I have fixed the merge, and will send nightly#205 to bors now. Back to :dancer:!
Unfortunately #37564 still needs some cleaning up. I've push a few fixes, but am again disappearing for a few hours.
There are some spurious additions of set_options that could be removed again before we merge.
scripts/grind_unused_lemmas.sh shouldn't really be in this, but I am tempted to sneak it in...
Okay, I am satisfied with #37564. Any last minute opinions before we put it in?
I'm offline for the rest of the day. Any chance someone could implement @Sébastien Gouëzel's review requests on this PR?

Alright, I've put in some final changes (mostly changing the linter to allow All rights reserved on its own line and not checking copyright on import-only files so that we don't need to set_option linter.style.header false) and am also now satisfied with #37564. I'd encourage everyone to look over the PR again but otherwise I think we're ready for a merge (and can investigate the #adaptation_notes post-merge).
Looks great, thank you. I'll send this to bors.
